principles: Phase 0 before any source edit: an approved manifest covering the current 767-line source is the prerequisite
Text-only translation: never change CLI control flow or logic while translating strings/comments
Behavior-sensitive matchers are not prose: defer M668/M669/M750 and re-scan for any other Chinese-matching runtime site before translating
Preserve all identifiers, enum values, JSON keys, filenames, legacy aliases, and template tokens
Lock the work with a no-new-Chinese gate so the migration cannot silently regress
drivers: Open-source readiness requires an all-English CLI surface and active docs
cli-engine.ts is the core 4031-line entrypoint; a mistranslated runtime matcher would break behavior
The user chose a single-story execution and accepted the larger diff

options.name: Single story, manifest-driven, with re-scan + gate + test updates

chosen: Single story, manifest-driven, with re-scan + gate + test updates
rationale: Per the user's directive. Phase 0 regenerates the manifest from the current 767-line source (re-anchoring sourceLine, adding the 5 drifted lines, carrying over approved English) and re-scans for runtime Chinese matchers; only then are strings replaced. Tests asserting old Chinese are updated in Phase 1; a no-new-Chinese gate (Phase 3) locks the result; M668/M669/M750 stay untouched (follow-up story).

preMortem.scenario: A Chinese string that is matched at runtime (a matcher not in the known 3) gets translated as prose
preMortem.trigger: An undiscovered regex/.test/.match/.includes over Chinese beyond M668/M669/M750
preMortem.consequence: Runtime detection silently breaks (e.g. a dry-run or guard branch never fires)
preMortem.mitigation: Phase 0 re-scans cli-engine.ts for ALL Chinese-matching runtime sites; any new one is flagged behavior-sensitive and deferred, never translated in this story

preMortem.scenario: Tests that assert old Chinese CLI output fail after translation
preMortem.trigger: Existing smoke/e2e tests hard-coding Chinese strings
preMortem.mitigation: Phase 1 enumerates (grep) and updates those tests in the same change; full validate run before advancing

preMortem.scenario: The 5 drifted lines (762->767) or shifted line numbers cause missed/duplicated translations
preMortem.trigger: Applying the stale 762-row snapshot directly to current source
preMortem.mitigation: Phase 0 regenerates the manifest from current source; the Phase 3 no-new-Chinese gate catches any residual Chinese in active source

preMortem.scenario: An identifier, enum value, or JSON key gets translated
preMortem.trigger: Bulk string replacement not respecting code tokens
preMortem.mitigation: Manifest preserves identifiers; replacements are scoped to chineseSource snippets; build + e2e + review catch breakage

preMortem.scenario: The large diff conflicts with concurrent main changes on merge
preMortem.trigger: Other active stories editing cli-engine.ts or docs while this runs
preMortem.consequence: Merge conflicts or regressions at DONE
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the story moving, rebuild + full validate after merging main, and rely on the no-new-Chinese gate + e2e to catch regressions
